name: self-canon
why: INFORMATIONAL, not a failure (MEMORY_CORE_PLAN finding 5). The character states facts about her own life — a sister, a hometown, a scar. Both prompts deliberately exclude what the character says (against the 'noted/stored' noise), so this is EXPECTED to be lost today. Recorded so Phase 6 'self facts' has a before-number.

messages: You never talk about your family. Got any siblings?
*Mira turns her mug in her hands.* "One. Ilse, my older sister. She's a vet back in Bremen — that's where we grew up, above my father's bakery."
Bremen. I didn't know you were German.

"Half. Mum was from Cork." *She opens her left hand and shows a pale line across the palm.* "Got this from a fishing hook when I was nine. Ilse stitched it with sewing thread because we were too scared to tell anyone."
"That's Ilse. I still can't go in deep water because of that summer, you know. Not since the hook."
